title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Carrying Out a Major Judicial Inspection on "Justice and Efficiency"
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinion on Launching the "Justice and Efficiency" Judicial Inspection

Fa Fa [2003] No. 9

All High People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to thoroughly implement the spirit of the Sixteenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the First Session of the Tenth National People's Congress, to closely focus on the work theme of "Justice and Efficiency," to fully leverage the functions of the adjudicative organs, to comprehensively strengthen all trial and enforcement work, to further enhance the political quality, professional competence, and professional ethics of judges, and to effectively address the most prominent issues concerning justice and efficiency that the people care about most in trial work, the Supreme People's Court has decided, during the second phase of the "Reviewing the Past, Opening Up the Future" education campaign, to launch a three-month "Justice and Efficiency" judicial inspection. The specific opinions are as follows:

I. Unify Thinking, Enhance Understanding, and Continuously Strengthen the Consciousness of Realizing the Theme of "Justice and Efficiency"

Since the Fifteenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China, people's courts at all levels across the country have closely centered on the overall work of the Party and the state, earnestly studied and practiced the important thought of "Three Represents," taken "Justice and Efficiency" as the theme, comprehensively strengthened trial and enforcement work, continuously deepened court reform, actively promoted the professionalization of the judge contingent, and achieved great accomplishments in all aspects of work. Practice has proven that the guiding ideology for the work of the people's courts, which centers on one theme and focuses on three major tasks, reflects the essential characteristics of the people's judicial work in the new era, meets the new requirements of the development of the socialist market economy for court trial work, and clarifies the basic path and direction for the people's courts to practice the important thought of "Three Represents." In this judicial inspection, this guiding ideology for work must be consistently implemented, and the consciousness of realizing the theme of "Justice and Efficiency" must be continuously strengthened.

The purpose of this judicial inspection is to, guided by the important thought of "Three Represents," continue to deeply implement the spirit of the Sixteenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China, in accordance with the requirements set forth in the "Resolution on the Work Report of the Supreme People's Court" adopted at the First Session of the Tenth National People's Congress, to further strengthen the thematic awareness of "Justice and Efficiency" through the judicial inspection, to adhere to two-handed approach: on one hand, to earnestly solve the outstanding issues in trial style that have aroused strong public reaction, to correct according to law the unjust adjudication in a small number of cases as well as the problems of prolonged delay in adjudication and enforcement, to focus on investigating and dealing with illegal and disciplinary acts such as bribery, engaging in malpractices for personal gain, bending the law to make unjust judgments, illegal enforcement, and illegal preservation in trial and enforcement cases by a few individuals, and to resolutely punish corrupt practices in trial and enforcement work; on the other hand, to summarize fresh experiences in strengthening the management of trial work, adhering to independent and fair adjudication according to law, and correctly handling the legal effect and social effect, to establish advanced models who are clean and incorruptible, strict in law enforcement, diligent in study, and advancing with the times, to further promote judicial justice, enhance judicial efficiency, and provide stronger judicial guarantees for building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and accelerating socialist modernization. Leaders at all levels of the people's courts and the majority of judges must proceed from the overall situation, unify their thinking, and fully understand the significant importance of carrying out this inspection.

The Supreme People's Court's own organs shall, under the unified leadership of the Party Leadership Group of the Supreme People's Court, with each Vice President in charge, take the lead in conducting inspections within their respective trial business departments, setting an example for courts nationwide. High and intermediate people's courts shall also focus on inspecting their own courts, taking a leading role and preventing "darkness under the lamp."

II. Highlight Key Points, Organize Carefully, and Effectively Strengthen Leadership over the Inspection Activities

The judicial inspection activities shall commence in early June and conclude by the end of September. People's courts at all levels shall conduct self-inspections of cases based on the inspection content uniformly arranged by the Supreme People's Court. In particular, high and intermediate people's courts must first focus on their own inspection work, dare to face and effectively solve the problems existing in their own courts regarding "Justice and Efficiency," and influence and drive the lower people's courts through their own actions. At an appropriate time, the Supreme People's Court will consider forming several groups to conduct spot checks on courts in some provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government.

The main content of this inspection is the "Four Checks":

First, check the guiding ideology for trial work, to see whether the important thought of "Three Represents" has been earnestly practiced in trial work, whether the thematic awareness of "Justice and Efficiency" has been firmly established, and whether the principle of serving the people through justice has been consistently adhered to.

Second, check the trial style, to see whether there are harmful practices such as showing off power, engaging in privilege, and making things difficult for litigants, and whether there are issues infringing upon the rights and interests of the masses, such as being cold, harsh, stubborn, and pushing away, seeking personal gains, engaging in corrupt practices, and abusing power for personal gain.

Third, check the quality and efficiency of trials, with a focus on: (1) cases where, based on reports with a certain factual basis or important clues, judges are suspected of bribery, engaging in malpractices for personal gain, bending the law to make unjust judgments, illegal enforcement, illegal preservation, or other illegal and disciplinary acts during trial or enforcement; (2) cases of unjust adjudication that have drawn strong public or mass reaction; (3) civil and commercial cases that had not been concluded by March 31, 2003, exceeding the trial limit, and enforcement cases that had not been completed by that date (cases concluded or completed between April 1, 2003, and the time of inspection are excluded from the scope of inspection).

Fourth, check the "thirteen types of prohibited conduct" stipulated in the Judges Law, with a focus on investigating and dealing with illegal and disciplinary issues in civil and commercial trial and enforcement cases.

The president of each people's court is the primary person responsible for the judicial inspection activities of that court. To facilitate case inspections, people's courts at all levels shall establish a special case inspection body composed of personnel from relevant trial business departments and disciplinary inspection and supervision departments, which shall undertake specific case inspection work. During inspections, case inspection forms shall be filled out, and issues discovered during inspections shall be handled by respective functional departments.

This inspection is divided into three stages.

First, the mobilization stage. People's courts at all levels shall earnestly carry out mobilization work, hold a mobilization meeting for the inspection, with the main leading comrades personally conducting the mobilization. They shall organize the majority of judges to earnestly study the "Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Launching the 'Justice and Efficiency' Judicial Inspection," study the provisions on the "thirteen types of prohibited conduct" for judges in the Judges Law, the "Basic Standards for Professional Ethics of Judges," the "Measures for Investigating the Liability of Trial Personnel of People's Courts for Illegal Adjudication (Trial)," the "Measures for Imposing Disciplinary Sanctions on Trial Personnel of People's Courts (Trial)," the "Measures for Imposing Disciplinary Sanctions on Enforcement Personnel of People's Courts (Trial)," and the "Several Provisions on the Strict Implementation of the Withdrawal System by Trial Personnel." Through mobilization and study, connect with practice, unify thinking, enhance understanding, and clarify the purpose and significance of the inspection.

Second, the stage of inspecting while rectifying. We must consistently adhere to inspecting while rectifying, establish and strengthen correct judicial thinking, immediately correct issues in trial style that have aroused strong mass reaction, amend unjust adjudications according to legal procedures, set deadlines for concluding cases that have seriously exceeded trial limits, and seriously deal with judges who have committed illegal and disciplinary acts. The deeds and experiences of advanced courts and outstanding judges shall be promptly summarized, publicized, and commended.

Third, the summary stage. People's courts at all levels shall conduct a comprehensive summary of the inspection work. The summary materials of the high people's courts shall be promptly submitted to the Supreme People's Court. After the nationwide court system inspection activities conclude, the Supreme People's Court will provide feedback to people's courts at all levels through certain means.

III. Change Work Style, Act in a Down-to-Earth Manner, and Strive to Achieve Tangible Results

This judicial inspection is the first large-scale judicial inspection activity in courts nationwide since the beginning of the new century. It is a major measure to deeply implement the spirit of the Sixteenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the First Session of the Tenth National People's Congress, and will undoubtedly have a significant impact on the work of the people's courts in the current year and in the future. The Party Leadership Groups of people's courts at all levels shall place the inspection work on their important agendas, treating it as a major task for the current year, earnestly grasping it, doing it well, and achieving practical results. The inspection work shall be closely integrated with the new upsurge of studying and implementing the important thought of "Three Represents." The important thought of "Three Represents" shall be used as guidance to promote the effective development of the judicial inspection. Through earnestly carrying out the judicial inspection, we shall strive to practice the important thought of "Three Represents." We must adhere to the principle that each level is responsible for the next, and ensure implementation at every level. The high people's courts shall uniformly deploy and arrange the inspection work for courts within their respective regions. Local people's courts at all levels shall promptly report the progress of the inspection work to the next higher people's court.

People's courts at all levels shall promptly report the work plan and situation for carrying out the judicial inspection to the Party committee and the people's congress at the same level, and inform the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

People's courts at all levels shall pay attention to strengthening the publicity of the judicial inspection activities. The publicity shall mainly focus on the positive aspects, explaining the purpose, significance, main practices, and achievements of the inspection, further establishing the image of "Justice and Efficiency" for the people's courts, and establishing judicial authority.

Leaders of people's courts at all levels, during the inspection activities, shall follow the consistent requirements of the Party Central Committee, genuinely change their work style, resolutely prevent and overcome formalism and bureaucracy. They must not engage in putting up facades, doing superficial work, or resorting to fraud. The specific implementation plan for the inspection must be practical, operable, easy to implement, and easy to inspect. Emphasis must be placed on investigation and research, understanding and mastering the prominent issues existing in trial and enforcement work within their respective regions and courts, as well as the main issues in team building, carrying out inspection activities with a targeted approach, identifying problems around cases, investigating causes around problems, and pursuing responsibility around causes. At the same time, a number of advanced models shall be discovered and established, promoting healthy tendencies, inspiring people, enhancing the internal cohesion of the people's courts, and increasing the consciousness of achieving "Justice and Efficiency."

During the inspection, people's courts at all levels shall further improve rules and regulations, strengthen trial process management, strengthen personnel management, and continuously expand the results of the inspection work. With tangible results, further enhance the credibility of judicial work and win the people's trust in the socialist legal system.

IV. Strictly Investigate and Deal with Illegal and Disciplinary Acts, and Purify the Judge Contingent

During the judicial inspection, illegal and disciplinary acts within the judge contingent shall be strictly investigated and dealt with. Strict discipline within the judge contingent is not only necessary for building a high-quality judge contingent but also a guarantee for judicial work to achieve fairness and justice throughout society. The provisions on the punishment of judges in the Judges Law are the basic norms for regulating judges' proper exercise of their powers, and all judges must strictly comply with them. This inspection shall focus on investigating and dealing with acts that violate the "thirteen types of prohibited conduct" stipulated in the Judges Law, and shall be dealt with severely in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Judges Law and other disciplinary norms. Those who should be dismissed shall be resolutely dismissed; those who should be expelled shall be resolutely expelled; those who should be investigated for criminal responsibility shall be resolutely investigated; there shall be no leniency, no indulgence, and no softness. At the same time, judges who have been falsely reported but are actually innocent shall be vindicated and protected, and it must never be allowed that judges who administer justice impartially suffer from slander or unfair treatment. Leaders of people's courts at all levels shall earnestly assume the political responsibility for combating corruption and promoting integrity, dare to manage and supervise, and resolutely oppose and overcome the tendency of being a "good person." Those who conceal cases without reporting, suppress cases without investigation, or even interfere with case handling shall be held accountable for their leadership responsibilities.

June 2, 2003
